items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: I stayed with Ben all the way. Ben was in my corner all the way. He didn't know if I was going to come back, but he still stuck with me

ctx.x: I stayed with Ben all the way. Ben was in my corner all the way. He didn't know if I was going to come back, but he still stuck with me and still sold the told (inaudible), I got money over here. If you ever need anything. -- I never got in debt. I never borrowed $100.00 from him. I took care of myself. I mean after the accident too.
